title: generator's in
description: What the main conversation gives the generator: its run values as it starts, and the orchestrator's decision as it resumes it. generator.md names this file, and the guard limits the generator's calls to the run values.

start.description: The run values, one JSON object on the first line of the prompt that starts the role, as the guard gives it from tree.py's cut, each one a value that the guard limits the role's calls to.

record.description: The path of the role's record, a file in the run's folder `records/` that the role writes only by record.py add, in the form of record.schema.json, and that rn's check reads at the role's end.

run.description: The run's folder, `.rn/<yyyymmdd>-<goal>`, from the root of the run's worktree.

deliverable.description: The path of the deliverable that the generator makes, from the root of the run's worktree, the one file or folder it writes in.

kind.description: The deliverable's kind, the name of the folder of its best practice, such as readme, or `specific`.

round.description: The number of the deliverable's round that this start makes, from 1.

cut.description: The path of the role's cut, the file that tree.py cut wrote in the run's folder, which holds the part of the design tree that the role starts with and nothing else.

made.description: The path where the generator writes what it made, in the form of `made` in generator-out.schema.json, in the round's folder.

resume.description: The message by which the main conversation resumes the role with SendMessage: its first line, then its decision on the role's last result and why, and, where the user answered, a line that opens the user's words as they wrote them, because a summary loses what the user meant.
